title: Ambient light intensity does not update after repeatedly setting `bg_energy_multiplier` when using a skybox
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.6-dev1, v4.5-stable, v4.4.1-stable (did not check older than that)

### System information

macOS Tahoe (26.0.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M3 Pro (Apple9) - Apple M3 Pro (11 threads) - 18.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

Ambient light intensity does not update after **repeatedly** setting `background_energy_multiplier`. Sky brightness changes, but the ambient light stays completely black.

Here I used a `PanoramaSkyMaterial`, but the same issue occurs with any other sky material (repro project uses procedural sky material):

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/43df187a-f604-4a04-9d9f-20936859bf03

### Steps to reproduce

```gdscript
extends Node

@export
var world_env: WorldEnvironment

var timer: float

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	timer += delta
	world_env.environment.background_energy_multiplier = abs(sin(timer))
	print(abs(sin(timer)))
```

Note that the following case would work OK:
```gdscript
world_env.environment.background_energy_multiplier = 1.0
```
(setting it to a constant value instead of computed one)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[ambient_light_bug_repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22682761/ambient_light_bug_repro.zip)
